name: Clevis
description: A clevis: a forked end with the pin through both cheeks.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(10% 12%, 90% 12%, 90% 34%, 44% 34%, 44% 66%, 90% 66%, 90% 88%, 10% 88%); clip-path: polygon(10% 12%, 90% 12%, 90% 34%, 44% 34%, 44% 66%, 90% 66%, 90% 88%, 10% 88%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 62%; top: 38%; width: 24%; height: 24%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
